pageProps.title: Ichon Shelter
pageProps.review: Enjoy the clean taste of simple Ongsimi Kal-guksu with chewy Ongsimi and savory potato pancakes that are not greasy at Ichon Shelter located in Daegwallyeong-myeon, Pyeongchang-gun, Gangwon-do.
pageProps.content: ## Ordered ```menu { "title": "Ongsimi Kal-guksu", "rating": 4 } --- Clean and simple. ``` ```menu { "title": "Potato Pancake", "rating": 4 } --- As expected, not greasy and simple. ``` ## Review The broth is not salty, so it's clean and simple. The kal-guksu goes well with the chewy ongsimi. It's a pity I couldn't eat much because I had indigestion at that time. ## Pictures
